description: Update a WEEEK task: title, natural-language `due` and `start` dates, priority (low, medium, high, hold), type (action, meet, call), `duration` estimate in minutes, `tags` by name or id (replaces the task's tags; an empty list clears them), and `fields`: custom-field values by field name (select options and members by name too; null clears; other fields keep their values). NOTE: description is NOT updatable — WEEEK's API silently ignores it on update; set it at create time or in the UI. Assignees, watchers, parent and projects have their own tools.

fields.description: Custom-field values by field name or id. text/link: a string; number: a number; boolean: true/false; datetime: a natural-language date or time; select: an option name; multiselect: option names; member/approval: member names; contact: a contact name or id; null clears the field.

tags.description: Replaces the task's tags; an empty list clears them.

name: weeek_update_task
